dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

redirectLink.description: The url to which the user is redirected upon clicking the label.

sortDirection.description: How should we sort the values, ascending or descending.

sortedBasedOn.description:
Should we sort based on the X values or Y values.
If sorting on X values, it will be sorted in alphabetical order.

sortField.description: The name of the y axis field to sort on.

title:
A specification that describes how to use each field of the {@link dataType} for display in the {@link UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChart}.
A single field is mapped to either X axis or Y axis, so an instance of this type specifies how to display the X axis
in a categorical line bar chart.
name: UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChartXAxisDataSpecSetting
